items.text: Step right up, Curators!

Take on the role of Funfair Expert, and prepare to reopen the gates of Two Point County’s once-legendary amusement park, after a decades-long hiatus. For years, the site at Riquetti Gardens has sat dark, rusty and guest-less - and there’s nothing amusing about that, hm?

Your new funfair will boast historic rides from Two Point County’s past, and as our resident Expert, you’ll have the chance to bring history to life for guests by building blueprints for immersive ride experiences that complement your existing museum themes.
Round a corner as you prepare a thrilling adventure for your museum guests, as high-octane engineering meets cultural curation.
Have questions about our latest DLC, Two Point Museum: Rides & Relics? Check out our full FAQ here.
Two Point Museum: Rides & Relics, with high-octane engineering and cultural curation.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4511680/Two_Point_Museum_Rides__Relics/"]
Create your very own personalised coasters across five unique themes.
Embark on expeditions to the abandoned Gearbox Fairgrounds
Discover a brand new museum location: Riquetti Gardens
Unfold a new five-star story campaign
Collect all ten new mascots, hidden across Expeditions
Meet a new expert type: Funfair Experts
Curate over 15 Funfair Exhibits, including the charming Antique Amusements
Check out new Gift Shop items
Discover fresh Funfair-themed items and decorations.
Landscape with new hedges, fences and outdoor items.
Enjoy a new range of utility items, such as a Helipad, Ticket Desk, benches, bins, and more!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/991ed0a62b5076c0484bbf0817508f2b0c3b40e2.png"]A Ticket to Vibe

We’re searching for Funfair Experts to revisit and reinvent wild rides, transforming the County’s old funfair into a one-of-a-kind mix of museum-meets-amusement park, or as we like to call it, a museum-ments.

You’ll juggle all the elements that go into curating a great funfair. Discover the highs within the technical art of Mascot Entertainment, and prove your expertise as you undertake building corkscrews near fragile artefacts. Curators will also need soft skills such as candy floss making and spannering (that’s Ride Maintenance, to you and me).
Coaster Curation

As our resident Expert, you’ll design the full loop of coastering journeys, creating your own custom coasters, tweaking everything from the height, tilt and camber to realise your own high-velocity dreams.

You’ll curate different coasters, ranging from the sombre Monobeast Metro for our less thrill-enthusiastic guests to high-octane spins and inversions with the steel coaster. As our resident engineering expert, you’ll have full control when placing the coaster’s supports, adjusting each track piece, adding track additions like chains and boosters, and even decorative pieces.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/c07252ec868873afddde80ef2eeb4baa424b5be8.gif"]
Dressed to Thrill

Alongside their long list of museum duties, your assistants can now get dressed to thrill, with everywhere to go, as new Museum Mascots, as they traverse your museum near and far to deliver immersive experiences to your guests, transporting them to a new world whilst they explore your museum, or wait in line for rides.

Mascot costumes transform your Assistants into walking, talking (kind of) characters. An entire range is available, each with its own effects and entirely new smells to discover across Expeditions in Two Point County. Mascots will bring joy (and hopefully not tears) to your guests across your museum empire, with mascots available across museum themes.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/63ee9f328cd06bf0331434c2777f4d8961f7a14e.gif"]
Ride of your Life

[p align="start"]As our new Experts, you should be happy to travel to the old abandoned park of Gearbox Fairgrounds on expeditions to uncover new thrilling blueprints and perks for this fresh adventure. You’ll help Gretchen Gearbox as she realises her grandfather’s dreams, revisiting his past rides - the marvels of engineering that they were - and bringing them up to modern Two Point County safety regulations, loose as they are.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/5cbb31ad83b1cb51e69886516b98f10dccba7118.gif"]
Thrill to Bits

[p align="start"]New Funfair exhibits not only provide Buzz and Knowledge, but a whole new rush in itself, providing Thrill. Previously untapped in the County’s museums, Thrill will increase your guests' desire to stay in the museum, thus offering a unique spin on maximising your guests’ visits, and of course, ride tickets, donations, and Gift Shop spend.

Your new funfair will boast historic rides from Two Point County’s past, and as our resident Expert, you’ll have the chance to bring history to life for guests by building blueprints for immersive ride experiences that complement your existing museum themes.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/9e74613e55645d9c3ad0dd881f2fafcc7548d631.png"]
Department of Amusement
[p align="start"]Experts with a background in award applications are a huge plus, as we’re eager to make history thrilling, with lofty goals to achieve Ride Ribbons and the perks that come with them.

Receiving certificates from the County’s Department of Amusement (is there a department for everything? No wonder the County spend is, ahem)… the Department of Amusement are a tricky bunch, who previously shut down Gearbox Fairgrounds, so make sure to keep rides well spannered and puddles properly mopped, if you’re to please them.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/476e6b67e482241b587958be0abfe60c9d0d73a5.png"]
[p align="start"]Welcome back to the Digiverse!

You made it just in time, friends. Someone spilt coffee all over an arcade machine, which has only gone and caused a minor temporal distortion in spacetime. Now, strange rifts have opened, leading to other worlds in a place/not-place they’ve named The Digiverse.
We’re thrilled to announce our next Digiverse Rift is in partnership with Double Dagger and Little Kitty, Big City…

Embark on an adventure of a lifetime as you explore the world of Two Point Museum and play as the most curious little kitty in Little Kitty, Big City, as two delightfully charming games unite, each with its own unique dash of chaos and mischief.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/85286/"] The Little Kitty, Big City rift is open for exploration (and mischief) in Two Point Museum right MEOW, available on all platforms.
Well, well, well, if it isn’t… Wait, you’re no kitty.
Say, you look like the kind of curator who enjoys a ludonarratively harmonious exhibit or two.. Have you heard about my exciting new business opportunity?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/5effc5ad2dfc3c4bdf2b0b797063efcc2de54875.png"]
Of course, we’ll need to find the kitty first. Keep your eyes peeled for a clumsy, sometimes-airborne cat! Oh - and Shinies!
Shinies are those gleaming doodads you find all over the place! In bushes, on ledges, under traffic cones… You’ll need them to access my premium Crow content!
With Crow's help, explore the Big City as you track down little kitty. Explore three Points of Interest (that’s POIs!) in the city, as you collect Shinies and exhibits for your museum.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/72b485bf62ef967b346e573d6eaf003dfb5dc269.png"]
As you gather Shinies, Crow will use their ancient Crow Ritual to reveal must-see Points of Interest for you to explore in the city.

You'll uncover three new exhibits for your museum, including a charming Hatted Chamolean, a Duck Pond Diorama, and the showstopper: your very own Little City Diorama, complete with THE adorable kitty!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/3fe247e951f1885d5eb7633aaa39b9659d34dbca.png"]Unlock new Perks in the workshop by using Shinies to boost your exhibits’ value and knowledge or even neutralise their biggest enemy: Dust! Also in the Workshop, you can craft a new Ledge Leaper interactive display with your Shinies, so all your visitors can enjoy a taste of Kitty’s adventure.
Across the three POIs, you'll also discover new decor pieces to help you create your very own street corner in the museum. Because, after all, what’s a statue without a Traffic Cone?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/53a5f30523f8fc74d45a9278c1f594b94d6021aa.png"]

[p align="start"]Each Exhibit you unlock on the Cult Rewards tree must be crafted in the Workshop to further your influence over your museum followers and increase the strength of your Museum Cult.
[p align="start"]You’ll unlock and craft fan-favourite buildings from Cult of the Lamb, from the Drum Circle to the Offering Statue and finally, the Temple.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/3e2c056674e274779f27974dbee90b17d78c4d37.png"]The Temple is the centre of your Cult. From there, you will grow stronger and perform Rituals to mould the minds of your followers.

[p align="start"]As your brave Expedition teams explore further into the land of false prophets, you’ll gain more and more Devotion to unlock more powerful Cult Rewards. From decorative items, new Exhibits and upgrades, alongside Rituals for your Temple.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/a081e2dcc0c9fc9e0be3cd7956921a022c4d494a.png"]With our Cult flourishing, I must thank you. By relieving me of my duties, you have granted me what I desire most: peace. Now that I have taught you everything you need to know, I can pass my days playing Knucklebones, and you alone must continue to curate a cult powerful enough to rival the false prophets that seek your demise.

Hey Curators!

[p align="start"]Today we kick off a month-long celebration as Two Point Studios turns TEN! (Where did the time go??). We’ve got a jam-packed season ahead, and this update? Consider it the starter to a full course coming very soon. You should definitely get some Gubbins and birthday cake ready for tomorrow.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/8229cf6d3c382725e04fa03f021f86347daa22e4.jpg"]

Expect new content, exclusive reveals, and quality-of-life updates alongside optimisations - tonnes of lovely Two Point goodness to keep your museum halls buzzing over the warmer months. But the best part? The cherry on top? To add some extra ✨sparkle✨ to all this lovely new content, this update is thanks to YOU. We couldn’t do this without every single one of you brilliant (and occasionally chaotic) Curators who’ve sent us your thoughts, feedback, and fantastic ideas. We’ve been listening, we’ve been brewing, and whilst there’s exciting new content still cooking, we’re here to do one thing to kick-start a fantastic summer: deliver!
[p align="start"]So, what’s new?
Celebrate the studio’s birthday with the Anniversary Cake & Staff Outfit
“Choose an Exhibit” on expeditions with full survey level, removing RNG
Earn new Twitch Drops, with items from Two Point’s past
More Emotions available on non-Art Exhibits
Place the Performance Stage outdoors
And much more… and more to come, sooner than you think!
Anniversary Cake & Outfit
[p align="start"]It’s a special time for the studio, as very soon, we turn ten! To mark the occasion, there are new Anniversary Items in-game so all Pointians can join in with the celebrations.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/4a279383bc814daaf95fb2bb0f7eece0829d61c1.png"]

Don your Staff with two new anniversary outfits, the Cake Topper and Party Hat. Plus, you can even get your guests involved with the new Anniversary Cake, a self-serve cake display where guests and staff alike can share a slice to increase their Food need.
[p align="start"]Choose an Exhibit

[p align="start"]A few months ago, we released a blog all about how we take on and action feedback from you lovely Pointians, and one of your top requests was the ability to set up repeating Expeditions. If you didn’t see that blog piece, we went into detail about how that was technically difficult, and we promised our design team were cooking up something to help.

Well, they’re here to DELIVER. Now, once a Point of Interest reaches max Survey Level, you can select which exhibit you want on the Expedition setup screen. Choosing an Exhibit increases the Expedition’s cost and duration; however, you can be guaranteed to get the exhibit you choose.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/0338c2f45bc732a17fc59bc130ff93d5307d4467.png"]Now, the pay-off here is that it doesn’t guarantee the Exhibit’s quality; you still need to use all the tools at your disposal to increase the chances of finding higher-quality Exhibits, but, for anyone looking to complete their Pristine collection, it’s now all the easier to guarantee the exhibit you want.
[p align="start"]Twitch Drops

[p align="start"]Celebrate our birthday in style, with some throwback items available as Twitch Drops. To earn Twitch Drops, watch your favourite streamers until 16th July to grab these drops celebrating our birthday.
[p align="start"]The items can be earned by watching Drop-Enabled streamers play Two Point Museum - you’ll know if a streamer has drop-enabled as it displays in their tags on Twitch!
[p align="start"]Watch 15 minutes to earn the Milk Keg, an item you might remember from your campus days. The Milk Keg is a wall-mounted unit that meets guests’ Drink need.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/5708cc85e12160265028a15fd8ef5a6c5cce651c.png"]After 30 minutes, you unlock the Leaflet Info stand, reminiscent of the leaflets in Two Point Hospital. This item will inform your guests all about your wonderful exhibits. And last but not least, by watching for 30 minutes, you’ll unlock the Ticket Reception, a throwback to our roots in the hospital again. This works just like a normal ticket desk.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/d0ebb42534a59c45b81958895e44f8fa2cb75c10.png"]
Two Point Museum Free Weekend!

[p align="start"]We’re excited to announce that Two Point Museum is FREE to play this weekend, starting 18:00 BST today you can jump in and try your hand at curation. If you’ve ever been on the fence about playing, now is the perfect time to try.
[p align="start"]Build incredible museums, discover bizarre artefacts to exhibit, and curate the perfect museum visit for your guests. Play for free now on Steam and Xbox until June 22nd.

Creative Curators,

[p align="start"]Don your berets and prepare to look pensively at things you don’t quite understand, as it’s about time Two Point Museum had a splash of culture, don’t you think? In preparation for Arty-Facts launching next week, you can now dip your toes in the paint bucket for FREE!

We know many of you will agree that it’s about time Two Point County had its own, world-class, art museum - and Two Point legend Zara Fitzpocket needs YOUR help to establish a cultural heart in Two Point County, on the site of an old industrial port.
[p align="start"]As part of the base game, you can now curate classics and commission original art at the dilapidated Undee Docks, which is in desperate need of a fresh lick of paint.

[p align="start"]*The free taster content for Arty-Facts is now available on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. We will provide more details about the Nintendo Switch 2 taster as soon as possible. Thank you for your patience.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/ce315117b485d2cbbad1af35c4b0476b8bc59d7d.png"]
Have questions about our latest DLC, Two Point Museum: Arty-Facts? Don’t worry, we’ve got you! Check out our complete FAQ here.
So, what’s on the canvas?

[p align="start"]Gather your best coveralls and beret, as you follow in Zara Fitzpocket’s footsteps to establish an arty cultural hub, ahead of the DLC release. The Arty-Facts free taster content includes:
A new location in the run-down industrial Undee Docks, where you’ll establish your art museum, and explore the campaign up to the first star.
Discover the first three Points of Interest of the new expedition map, Zara’s Sketchbook.
Build the new Studio Room to commission original Painting Exhibits.
All other Stars in the campaign and Points of Interest, along with their associated objectives and items, will require the complete Arty-Facts DLC, which opens 7th May.
A new Arty-Fact Expert can be hired in any museum via a job advert, after gaining one star in Memento Mile and while playing the first star of the Arty-Facts campaign.

[p align="start"]As our new resident Art Expert, you won’t just be in charge of standing around looking pensive (although that is 70% of the role), you’ll also be responsible for establishing a brand new Art Studio in the museum, creating new works to evoke a broad range of emotions in guests to the museum gallery… a gallery-um as it were!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/d89395a71f07847653242876aae2de26a2577c2d.png"]
The full Arty-Facts DLC release May 7th for PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Details about the Nintendo Switch 2 release will follow as soon as possible.

[p align="start"]To explore the Arty-Facts campaign and commission art in Undee Docks, you’ll need to have completed Memento Mile Act 1, our lovely city location. Or if you can’t wait, you can jump into the paint bucket from the get-go, in sandbox mode.

[p align="start"]Curators can now find five new unique posters in-game, celebrating charity heroes who raised funds for the RSPCA during our Zooseum campaign. [p align="start"]We’re excited to deliver mouse & keyboard support to our console curators. We know it’s been long-requested, and we know many of you will enjoy the extra level of control it gives you when creating your museums.

items.text: Welcome back to the Digiverse!

[p align="start"]You made it just in time, friends. Someone spilt coffee all over an arcade machine, which has only gone and caused a minor temporal distortion in spacetime. Now, strange rifts have opened, leading to other worlds in a place/not-place they’ve named The Digiverse. If you need a reminder of what the Digiverse is, you can read more about the digital phenomenon here.

[p align="start"]We’re excited to announce our next Digiverse Rift is in partnership with Rovio and Angry Birds. Along with your usual traditional exhibits and interactive displays, this time the temporal spill has gotten a little out of control… A few living beings from the other side are trying to make their way into your museum, and these Bad Piggies are after your gold, eggs, and golden eggs.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/e9bc9b80a7c62ff25dc581fc6e2d8442e0131d6d.png"]

Two Point experts discovered a crack in the fabric of the Digiverse and have only gone and unveiled a whole entire scheme. On the other side of this crack is the Angryverse, and Bad Piggies have gone and stumbled directly into a rift between both worlds. They’re now launching missions across the County to infiltrate top museums! Only your best Digital Experts can address this new threat, and they must venture forth into a new world to discover how best to combat this new guild of thieves.

Explore three POIs (that’s Points of Interest) to discover artefacts from the Angryverse. You’ll find new exhibits and even brand-new roaming attractions for your museums, which may just help combat pesky swines.

Alongside the new Angry Birds Digiverse Rift, curators can now spruce up their museums with new Spring Seasonal items, new highly requested outdoor toilets and picnic benches, as well as a whole spring hamper of new stuff - including those of the chocolate variety - with plenty of quality-of-life treats, too.

[p align="start"]Curator, do you have any experience with dealing with dirty, rotten behaviour? Well! Your help may just be what the Angryverse needs; they just have to get a new security system for their eggs…
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/b3dcf34b2d0d2afd1011cb7f1b248da7e143f40e.png"]

Traversing across Digiverse realms, Matilda needs your help (yes, you, curator!) in saving eggs from the clutches of pesky piggies. You’ll need to enlist the help of roaming birds if you’re to stop this new guild from literally snorting up your donations.

[p align="start"]Meanwhile, over on the other side, the Piggies have stolen a Golden Egg and taken it aaaaall the way to Pig City. Which is pretty much the worst place it could be. Tempers are certainly flying high.

[p align="start"]Your adventure, strange human-curator that you are, begins in Cobalt Plateaus, where the signature blue stone of Piggy Island frames the landscape, and can be found wobbling up high and toppling down low.

[p align="start"]There, you’ll discover a first for Two Point County: free bird Wildlife exhibits. In Cobalt Plateau, you’ll discover Red, who’ll roam freely around your museums, exciting guests, and even helping to stop criminals, including the Bad Piggies, in their tracks.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/3c5b16d2ce593cb0019543a386bc85b71646025e.png"]

Slingshotting yourself out of the Plateau, you’ll fly onwards to the lush Bamboo Forest. There, your Experts will need to fly high if they’re to discover the way forward. They will delve into the thick, quick-growing forest to find the route forward.

[p align="start"]Here is where you’ll find the rest of the gang, as Chuck and Bomb join you in your museum, alongside further pig fortresses. These structures are of delicate porcine planning, designed to keep birds out.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/0b551b0d6e4abcd784e3c68af47dbc664d369006.png"]Once discovered and placed in your Museum, Red and the gang can daze and reveal criminals, leaving them sitting ducks for your Security Guards! Once you’ve discovered an Angry Birds exhibit, a new crime guild, The Bad Piggies, will invade your museum through rifts, targeting donation stands, information stands, and the very important eggs you discover.

[p align="start"]You’ll finally come across the illustrious Pig City. The feather-free capital of Piggy Island is full of pigs (unsurprisingly). When they get their hands on an Egg, this is where they bring it. As the ultimate Pig Fortress, the city has been toppled and un-toppled, time and time again.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/f00b481a20fe15a73b9166d35d2dd3786dd89b93.png"]
Experts can explore Piggy Island, visiting three new POIs: Cobalt Plateaus, Bamboo Forest and Pig City
Dress your guests with Angry Birds merch with new Gift Shop items
Collect nine exhibits, including an interactive display and new roaming Wildlife exhibits
Decorate with new items, wallpaper and flooring to create your very own Angryverse Museum
[p align="start"]Flowers are budding all across Two Point County, enough to make sure every bunny has an absolutely cracking day!

[p align="start"]Make sure not be late for this very important date, as we spring into an ear-resistible bonnet of Spring surprises. Whether it’s items ready for blossoming, a couple of dozen eggs, or bright new customisations, we’ve got the update that’s sure to ruffle some feathers. Let's hop to it:

Two Easter Isles have sprung up, manifesting in an area of intense culinary magic, enchanting the Scorched Earth with their specific type of confectionery sweetness. You’ll find these two chocolate-y POIs (that’s Point of Interest) near the compass in the South West corner of the Scorched Earth map.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/ef161640b4dff81204d1d678ca7d3e2c14e17bef.png"]

[p align="start"]First, you’ll embark to the Coacoapelago, an atoll of magical islands framing the southern coast of Scorched Earth, where even from the mainland the air is now sickly sweet with the inviting waft of chocolate eggs.

[p align="start"]There, your Experts will be inspired, bringing home egg-ravaging new ideas for blossoming decor. These springtime treats will do more than give your museum a spring clean, however, as these egg-citing discoveries will entice a brand new visitor type to your museum: Egg Hunters.

If you manage to impress these Hunters with your cracking finds, you’ll then have the opportunity to embark onwards to Bon Bon Boondox, a region notorious for being more than a spoonful of sugar sweet.

[p align="start"]It’s not all sunny-side up on this new Isle, as on the quest for chocolate eggs, your staff may be in for a Fowl Surprise, or perhaps even a bad hare-day. The region is well-known for many seasoned explorers going missing; perhaps they decided to stay where the grass is sweeter? You’ll be the one to find out.
Hop over to two new egg-travegent Points of Interest that make up the Easter Isles, hidden away in Scorched Earth.
Explore to find three new exhibits, including a new cute and fluffy Habitat critter and new Botany discoveries.
New customisation options for your walls and floors.

…and a whole basket full of chocolate eggs!
[p align="start"]Seasonal POIs are a bit special; they only appear during the seasonal event. Plan your expeditions to discover the new basket of goodies on offer, whilst the event is live.

[p align="start"]The Easter Isles are ready for exploration, and you’ve plenty of time to fill your basket and collect your blooming exhibits before May 30th. And don’t worry, we’ll post plenty of reminders before it’s time to say goodbye to spring’s blooms.
[p align="start"]In the settings menu, you can now choose between each seasonal event, meaning you can revisit the seasons whenever you please.

[p align="start"]And the best bit: decorations are forever! Once you’ve unlocked the lovely seasonal decorative items, they’re yours to keep, no matter the season. Plus, the event’s POIs will make an annual return, just like the turning of the seasons themselves. So, you can always revisit them next year to enjoy the fresh blossoms!

[p align="start"]We heard you loud and clear, Curators! The well-seasoned explorers amongst you will be glad to hear that new Curator-Class rewards are up for grabs to reward you for your continued efforts in the higher levels of museum management.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/ca595ebab29b63ccd0e7bb7da42841be6e47898d.png"]

These extra shiny items will bring extra utility to your museums, where now guests will be able to ‘self-serve’ when purchasing a museum ticket, or even for Gift Shop purchases, freeing up some of your ever-busy, multi-skilled Assistants. Alongside these is a dazzlingly new high-tech security archway, complete with lasers (of, course), and a bank full of shiny golden items to show off your prestigious reputation amongst curators across the County.

[p align="start"]​These lovely rewards will automatically unlock for those of you who have gone above and beyond in the realm of mayhem management. If you’re working towards your museum legacy, the new rewards are seen from Curator Class 9 all the way through to 15.

[p align="start"]If you didn’t know, new outdoor items ranked X in our community feedback round-up (which you can read more about here). An outdoor toilet ranked top amongst those suggestions, and we’re here to deliver.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/9494be0bd48c491a52f38a03b997556aac1b5033.png"]

To top off your new park areas, Vending Machines are now placeable inside and out so now you can now create the perfect picnic area, complete with facilities, right in time for the spring season. We’ll keep working on new outdoor items in future updates, too, so keep your ideas coming in!
[p align="start"]Ferreted away in a small basin in Farflung Isles, the previously thought lifeless waters of Briny Bay have surprised even well-adventured Experts.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/44b36130b315bcdec216aaa9ed1fb14f71517bd8.png"]You can now explore the cold, brackish depths to discover a new marine life exhibit. The saline levels of this stretch of water are perfect for resigning oneself to floating along limply as powerful current buffet you this way or that, for fish who are tired of swimming, and aren’t blubbered either way.
[p align="start"](with more to come, too!)
[p align="start"]We heard you loud and clear and have delivered new sandbox options so you’re able to fine-tune your sandbox mode experience event further.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/2e4a98c9994e00f72baffd94c21b6af52684a82e.png"]When customising your sandbox, you can now unveil the entirety of the Expedition Maps, unlocking all Points of Interests, and even setting survey level to start at it’s max level, meaning Pristine Exhibits can be found immediately.

We know there’s more settings you’d like to see in sandbox, and we’re working towards adding more functionality as we go, check out this blog here for more about our process behind implementing these - and, keep the suggestions coming!

[p align="start"]It’s now easier than ever to differentiate between where or what items are in your Items Menu, and there’s even new Filters for the Inventory that houses your Exhibits and Interactive Displays.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/fb5f6f42f1acfab0a5e27d1b5c8529bb1ced8a4d.png"]

[p align="start"]New icon backgrounds means you can easily see where an item is from, so there’s no need to search high and low for new seasonal or DLC items going forward. Alongside this, in the Inventory, you can now use the new tabs to filter by Exhibit Theme, which is extended across the Interactive Display and Utilities menus too.

Welcome back to the Digiverse…

[p align="start"]You’re just in time, friends. Someone spilt coffee all over an arcade machine, and it might have caused a minor temporal distortion in spacetime. This unusual activity has opened up rifts that lead to other worlds in a place/not-place they’ve named The Digiverse. If you need a recap of what the Digiverse is, check out the digital phenomenon here.

[p align="start"]We’re thrilled to announce our next Digiverse Rift is in partnership with Racoon Logic Studios and Revenge of the Savage Planet, where you’ll not only discover vivid alien wildlife in Two Point Museum, but this time, the temporal spill has gone both ways, and you’ll find Museum goodies in Revenge of the Savage Planet itself…
So you can properly curate the galaxy, we’ve bundled with Revenge of the Savage Planet, so if you don’t already own it, you can jump in now for a steal:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/62166/Two_Point_Museum_x_Revenge_of_the_Savage_Planet/"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/de61f12a9738a5679f91e4888814bd42f8f06862.png"]Two Point experts have uncovered a rift in the Digiverse, leading to a mysterious planetary system teeming with intriguing alien flora and fauna. Explore three Points of Interest as you collect exhibits from Revenge of the Savage Planet, wowing guests with the vibrant and sometimes… anxious, fauna of the Savage Planet, like the beloved Brainard, alongside bitey flora from the franchise, which we recommend you um, not make eye contact with, just in case.

There are six new exhibits to collect, with new items for the Staff Room that bring a splash of the space age to the otherwise… earthly, decor of Two Point County. There are new decorative items, as well as a brand-new sci-fi Staff Outfit.
[p align="start"]Welcome to the Pioneer Program!

[p align="start"]Greetings, fellow space settlers! Isn’t it neat, hopping through a rip in digital spacetime? I’d take that over a century asleep in an ALTA Cryo-Pod any day… Anyway, we’re here to establish a flourishing foothold for humanity in deep space! And a crucial element of our mission is to catalogue the pristine alien ecosystems, which fits with your… what are you? A curator? Keeper? Regardless, it’s now in your job description, so let's get cataloguing.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/867b3ac82ad40a0cbd52808ed0e6a6a634732d0d.png"]

First up, you’ll need to recruit a fleet of specialised experts. We don’t know what we’ll be up against, so it's best to come prepared. The first planet we’ve reached is Stellaris Prime, a dense jungle world. Vibrant, colourful, mildly toxic, with a strange obsession with mushrooms - the usual. It’ll also serve as our home base for this little adventure.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/df93e2007ec9fc3423890bce76a50a149feb5d8b.png"]

Once you’ve discovered the little guys of Stellaris Prime (aren’t they adorable?), you’ll be up for the challenge of Xephyr. Desolate. Sandy. Course and rough and oh-so irritating. The flora here may be less happy to see you; they’re in the market for any prospective snack, so keep arms and digits inside your space suit, please.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/ef8e3a11412e8aed9e91065e377bb1e68e7feeea.png"]

Now adept at intergalactic digitalised space fare, it’s time to discover new materials in the depths of space, like the incredibly precious, ahem, Aluminium (did Glurp really have the monopoly on that?).
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/56d92e2539108f8f355f741f54704e81effbffaa.png"]

On your space-age adventure, you’ll collect six new exhibits across three new POIs, unlocking futuristic goodies alongside a suite of sci-fi gadgets for your staff. Just be careful the guests don’t get any ideas about mixing the fruity texture of the Kiwi Slug with a good old pack of Gubbins… whilst delicious, they may, um, become hallucinatory (trust us, we tested it, in the name of science, of course! Definitely not lunch.)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/6f7e520f3d22a98d5e7bd0f261d7595e209d8c38.png"]

[p align="start"]For Zooseum players, five new large centre-piece items are now available for your Habitats to elevate the rooms! These new decor items can now be found on POIs on the Farflung Isles Expedition Map, and once unlocked, are purchased with Kudosh.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/e8931b828eefb7a4712df94870e21ce98bdca712.png"]

releases.displayName: Gingerbread Village | New Winter Seasonal Update!

items.text: Warmest of wishes, Pointians!

[p align="start"]A frosty spell has hit Two Point Museum! Time to wrap up warm, dust off your festive decor, and get ready to explore as you lavish your staff and museums in gifts, because the Winter Seasonal Update is here! From today, you can expect a whole host of yuletide treats… maybe keep them frozen, OK?

Frost and foremost, three brrrrilliant POIs (that’s Points Of Interest!) have frozen over, sat above Cold Mines in the Bone Belt. So get hats and scarves ready as you prepare to dash through the snow in a no-horse close-topped plane.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/9a19625507c7caf59d68ba641fda740222db6cd0.png"]

[p align="start"]First, you’ll embark to the first of three new POIs: the magical Gingerbread Village. The jolly hamlet appeared overnight, as if by some meticulous culinary magic. Such are the transformative, biscuit-y powers of the holiday season. With their winter coats dusted off, your experts will discover a hamper of fabulous decor and exhibits before exploring the icy fields of Festive Fleeces and the frozen Bauble Breach.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/67ff399219820f6160bd9aa5af2c37285a649b50.png"]

Get your staff all dressed up with snow-where to go (except to Gingerbread Village, of course) by weathering your staff in merry Santa and Elf Outfits. Freeze the day and decorate your museum for winter with a sleigh-full of new decorations, wallpapers, floors, and handy utility items to bring sparkle and joy to your museum halls.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/85359a460ea5b5f715036bfada3acb3c13ffc059.png"]Give your Museums a bright and jolly makeover to really bring the cosiness in. Gift-wrapped decorations and Santa’s Workshop red brick archways are now available, with winter nutcrackers to stand sentinel, silently judging your guests. If you’re partial to some merry decor, then rejoice with festive wreaths and winter rugs. For those who are anti-big light, bring some sparkle to your museums and deck the whole place in fairy lights and glowing Polar Lamposts!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/131088894ef880a68cb9b78edb19e85c0b844f1d.png"]

Just like the nippy weather, your exhibits and decor appreciate the chilly temperatures inside your museums. If things heat up, they may reveal something… any ice-blue items may have a special surprise for you!
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]So, what’s new?
Dash through the snow to three Points of Interest that make up Winter Town, tucked away in the Bone Belt
Explore to find five new exhibits, including a new interactive display that’ll bring your guests some festive cheer!
Jolly new customisable options for your walls and floors
Bring festive cheer with new free decor items: festive wreath, nutcracker, rugs… and more!
Bundle up tight with two new staff outfits
…and a whole partridge in a pear tree!
How does it work?
[p align="start"]Seasonal POIs are a bit special; they only appear during the seasonal event. So, plan your expeditions to discover the new festive fines on offer, whilst the winter event is live.

[p align="start"]Snow worries: we wouldn’t dream of melting your gifts early. Gingerbread Village and its neighbouring POIs are ready for exploration, so collect your brrrrilliant exhibits before February 28th. And don’t worry, we’ll post plenty of reminders before it’s time to pack away your hats and scarves.

[p align="start"]And the best bit: decorations are forever! Once you’ve unlocked the lovely seasonal decorative items, they’re yours to keep, no matter the season. Plus, the event’s POIs will make an annual return, just like the turning of the seasons themselves. So, you can always revisit them next year for another cocoa!
​Hey Curators,
The management chaos in Two Point County never sleeps! (… well, except for the Unflapybara, he’s on his sixth nap of the day).

We need your immediate attention, Curators, at a brand-new initiative in the County: our very own wildlife sanctuary-slash-museum… a Zooseum, if you will—the latest venture from the notoriously generous and known eccentric, Wiggy Silverbottom. Pack your best khaki shorts and poop scoop, as you embark to the tranquil Silverbottom Park, on the County’s hairiest journey to date, ahead of the full Zooseum release later this winter.

The County’s very own Kudoshillionaire, Wiggy, has, ahem, once again (!!) gotten himself in a spot of trouble with the local council, something to do with chopper licenses (this time). He needs a hand setting up an educational rehabilitation centre for wildlife from the troubled Farflung Isles.
[p align="start"]

[p align="start"]This new museum, which you’ll set up in one of Wiggy’s drafty stately manor parks, is all yours*! Curators (or should we say, keepers?) can now start working up to the first star in Silverbottom Park, as part of the Zooseum Taster! This content is a permanent addition to Two Point Museum’s base game, complete with all its warts and claws.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/5c68268df5057919df024cca72e7396dd568539f.png"]
Have questions about our latest DLC, Two Point Museum: Zooseum? Don’t worry, we’ve got you! Check out our complete FAQ here.
Gather your best khaki shorts and poop scoop, as you embark on the County’s hairiest journey to date, ahead of the DLC release. The Zooseum free taster content includes:
A new museum location, where you’ll set up your Zooseum in the beautiful Silverbottom Park, and explore the campaign up to the first star
Discover Points of Interest on the new Expedition Map, Farflung Isles
Build two new animal-related rooms
Create new workshop items
Unlock new decor
Rehabilitate three Habitat Animals alongside four Tearrium critters!
All other Stars in the campaign and Points of Interest, along with their associated objectives and items, will require the complete Zooseum DLC, which opens later this winter.
New high-level Curator Class Rewards
Overhaul to Exhibit Inspector
Aquarium capacity changes
….and much more!
[p align="start"]If you like what you curate, please wishlist Zooseum! It makes a huge difference, press the button right meow:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3804850"]
[p align="start"]A (literal) island full of new content awaits, so let’s delve into our highlights! If you want to skip to the full changelist, it’s below.

[p align="start"]Gather your best khaki shorts and poop scoop, as you embark on the County’s hairiest journey to date. Fantastic news for you, curators! You can now prepare to be a force for nature early, in anticipation of the whole Zooseum adventure dropping later this winter.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]The full Zooseum DLC releases December 2nd for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S. The Nintendo Switch 2 version will follow in Q1 2026.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/326df50f9a833853fe09bdc8490f07c99364232e.png"]
A new museum location, where you’ll set up your Zooseum in the beautiful Silverbottom Park, and explore the campaign up to the first star
Discover 3 Points of Interest on the new Expedition Map, Farflung Isles
Build two new animal-related rooms
Create new workshop items
Unlock new decor
Rehabilitate three Habitat Animals alongside four Tearrium critters!
All other Stars in the campaign and Points of Interest, along with their associated objectives and items, will require the complete Zooseum DLC, which opens later this winter.

[p align="start"]To explore the Zooseum campaign and embark to Silverbottom Park, you’ll need to have completed Memento Mile Act 1, our lovely city location. Or if you can’t wait, you can jump into hairy mayhem from the get-go, in sandbox mode.

[p align="start"]We heard you loud and clear, Curators! The well-seasoned explorers amongst you will be glad to hear that new Curator-Class rewards are up for grabs to reward you for your continued efforts in the higher levels of museum management.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/7fcff9923bb40c33ac29bb7ce2c215f27cff183e.gif"]

​These lovely rewards will automatically unlock for those of you who have gone above and beyond in the realm of mayhem management. If you’re working towards your museum legacy, the new rewards are seen at Curator Class 7 and 8.

[p align="start"]For another heavily requested change, the calculations that run under the filter in your Aquariums have been rejigged, which has changed the capacities for fish in your aquariums. We heard from Curators across the County that smaller aquariums were feeling a bit sparse, so while minimum-sized aquariums are not affected, the room size required to reach a capacity of 4 fish and above has been reduced.

[p align="start"]No longer will you scratch your head, wondering “why oh why are my fish not happy?”! We’ve overhauled the exhibit inspector UI, making everything clearer and easier to grab top-level information quickly. This is especially true for your Polterguest, Marine Life and new Animal Exhibits, where you’ll be able to see what’s bothering them much more easily using the new sub-tabs available, alongside changes to the text and layout.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/671a23819ae76d2bd95f84d141d218f5312ec26c.gif"]
As usual, this update also comes with a load of bug fixes, improvements and optimisation changes.
[p align="start"]

[p align="start"]Thank you all (again!) for providing feedback, sending us your ideas, reporting bugs and giving us suggestions for new content. If you’d like to send us your thoughts for future content or updates, or show us your fab museums, here’s the place to do that:

Welcome back to the Digiverse…

You’re just in time friends, someone spilt a coffee all over an arcade machine and it might have caused a minor temporal distortion in space-time… This unusual activity has opened up rifts that lead to other worlds in a place/not-place they’ve named The Digiverse.
If you need a recap of what the Digiverse is, check out the digital phenomenon here.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/cdaaee73bf477b96927a2ef3f9149b5078d93e56.png"]You’ve braved two rifts in the Digiverse, and we’re thrilled to bring you our third! Our next exciting crossover is with poncle’s iconic Vampire Survivors, the supernatural indie phenomenon that lets you be the bullet hell!
Two Point experts have uncovered a rift, plagued by evil, and despite reservations, they've bravely pressed on after hearing there might be free roast chicken.

Explore three Points of Interest as you collect exhibits from Vampire Survivors, equipping staff with offensive weapons, like the legendary Garlic or Santa Water, to help them survive. Or, why not leave relics on display to the possible dismay, or joy, of your vampire guests? There are 10 new exhibits to collect, alongside decor and a bundle of wallpapers and flooring to build your very own Inlaid Library.

[p align="start"]Ciao, curators! Don’t mind the smell as you dive into a temporal rift in the fabric of reality and explore the world of Vampire Survivors. Keep your feet moving and your eyes peeled for monsters (you know… peeled, like garlic) in three brand new Points of Interest.

Each Point of Interest has your brave Experts explore a famous stage from Vampire Survivors, starting in the Mad Forest. Once a thriving haven, now a dumping ground for evil. A vampire is said to be the root of the evil there, but we can find only mayhem and floor chicken.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/24044605107f64591f52f8b8716c5e1bed68e5a7.gif"]

Amass offensive weapons from Vampire Survivors as Mythical Gear for your museum and staff. This special subcategory of exhibit can be displayed in your museum as usual, or equipped by staff. Once adorned in these items, your team members are granted special bonuses and may even counter some of the evil hordes you encounter as you explore.

Feeling brave? If you’ve amassed a collection of weapons, buffs and stats, perhaps try running a detailed expedition… what could go wrong?[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/417fee31582a47ea6a39fa089d327e7df6e4f374.png"]

Once the Mad Forest is bested, you’ll adventure onwards into the Inlaid Library, where you’ll discover a new subcategory of Digiverse Exhibits: Relics. These mysterious exhibits hold mystical properties that may bestow XP buffs onto your staff, for only a slight catch, of course. After all, who wouldn't want to mess around with magical buffs from an unexplored digital realm?

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/1929b488b86cc166e8a602c95f83b596538652a8.png"]Collect 10 new exhibits across the three new POIs as you unlock digitised decor goodies alongside a new savoury Floor Chicken Casserole for your guests to enjoy in the Cafetaria (don’t worry about it, 20 seconds and 30 minutes are the same to Two Point County health inspectors, trust us). Just be careful your Vampire Guests don’t see garlic, and be nice to Poe when he visits, please.

items.text: Happy hauntings!

Strange things are afoot in Two Point County as we pass into harvest and the leaves start to turn. To spell-abrate the season’s turning, a local circle of witches has opened its quiet corner of the Netherworld. Pack your potion bottles and favourite toad, as we trudge through the pumpkin patch to explore Coven Corner.
Spell-abrate the Spooky Season…

This eerily spooky POI (that’s Point of Interest!) has manifested, tucked underneath the Paranormal Detection Agency near Curses, Curses, Curses in the Netherworld. Coven Corner offers a quiet respite for witches to gather and focus on their brews, and you might just find them willing to share some of their Witch Crafts with you, lovely curator, if you can dodge a curse or two…
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/62b87e0686eb9f1745e84a3b7d3a8325b0f516fe.png"]

Alongside discovering new exhibits, where wolf we be without some new decor? Fall into the season with a bushel of new decorations and handy utility items to bring the harvest spirit to your museum halls. Displaying Witch Crafts may attract a new visitor type to your museum, and it’s best to impress them rather than fall under their spell.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/7295093acc8b6a9adea5c108877530c69fa031b0.png"]So, what’s new?
A gourde-geous new point of interest tucked away in a quiet corner of the Netherworld
Three new hex-citing Witch Crafts to discover, a new exhibit type in the Supernatural theme
A bale-ful of grain-tastic utility items: an autumnal archway, alongside a haystack bench and corner bench

A cornucopia of autumnal decor, such as a barrow, wall basket, pairs of pumpkin and banner set
Two new wallpaper and flooring options to give your exhibits a fall makeover
A new neighbouring Witch visitor, they may cast a spell over your museum, good or bad? Well, you best impress them…
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/b64030d755529cc517a0e421c5be8306202df945.png"]
How does it work?
Seasonal POIs are a bit special; they only pop up during the seasonal event time. So, plan your expeditions to Coven Corner to discover the new witch-crafts on offer, whilst the autumn event is live.

Fear not, as we wouldn’t dream of rushing spell casting. Coven Corner is available for hex-cellent witchy crafts until November 30th. And don’t worry, we’ll cast plenty of reminders before it’s time to pack away your cauldron.

And the best bit: decorations are forever! Once you’ve unlocked the lovely seasonal decorative items, they’re yours to keep, no matter the season. Plus, the seasonal POI will make an annual return, just like the turning of the seasons themselves. So, you can always revisit Coven Corner next year for another brew!

[p align="start"]This unusual activity has opened up rifts that lead to other worlds in a place/not-place they're calling The Digiverse, a new (FREE) expedition map.

[p align="start"]These rifts look a tad volatile, but it doesn’t look like anything to fear… yet. We should definitely monitor it to see if anything changes. They look big enough to fly a chopper into, so, in the name of exploration, how about we open this thing up and take a look inside?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/6ccd99290c15dba2f614775ee3832ed4d21bacc5.png"]

The Digiverse is officially open for business, and the first two rifts are ready to be explored: Meat Wizard and DREDGE. The Digiverse is a brand-new expedition map, available once players start the second star in Memento Mile. Each rift holds new Points of Interest (POIs), exhibits, decorations, and more.

[p align="start"]In the first rift, start your Digiverse adventure by hiring new Digital Experts to send into the unknown, as they explore video game history across Two Point County’s favourite video game series, Meat Wizard. Four points of interest await, brimming with retro exhibits, quirky decor and workshop items.

[p align="start"]In an exciting new crossover with Black Salt Games' fishing adventure DREDGE, your brave explorers, alongside Marine Life experts, can then captain a fishing trawler into the shadowy waters of the DREDGE rift. Explore a collection of three remote islands, and their surrounding depths, to see what lies below. Haul in ten new catches, unlock new aquarium decor, and kit your team with a fresh staff outfit.. Be careful, though, we’d advise you don’t set sail at night… Good luck!

[p align="start"]Opening up that rift has unfurled all kinds of pathways across the digiverse. Was that advised? Who knows! This place doesn’t conform to the rules of our time. Get transported inside the Meat Wizard franchise and hire an expert in the field of digital exploration to take a look around. Maybe you’ll discover something for the museum?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/b6241416832772fdf7993d3efa4f2d105c2cf0d5.png"]

As you adventure across County video game history, you’ll find new exhibits, interactive displays, and Power-Ups; craftable in the workshop with a Digital Expert qualified in Button Master. They have various handy uses - to you guessed it - power up your museums. Plus, who wouldn’t want to use experimental, powerful bonuses from an unexplored digital realm?
Will your experts meat their fates, or can they delve deeper, avoid Brorcillis, and discover the design flaws of Meat Wizard 3D…
Explore a nostalgic trip into the County’s video game history
Adventure in Meat Wizard 1 & 2, and perhaps discover the franchise’s darkest secret…
Discover seven new Exhibits across four new Points of Interest
Build two new Interactive Displays: Meat Wizard Arcade Machines
Find and unlock Power Ups, a new boon-giving project for the workshop
[p align="start"]

Ahoy there! You’re a new face - a fisherman, I take it? Well, we should get along like a house on fire! Starting from the remote archipelago ‘The Marrows’, you can take to the water and scour the depths for deep-sea denizens. You shouldn’t linger past dark though… you might not like what finds you in the night.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/30f346bd1adce48ae0e86de8d29066b9c17b5e49.png"]

Be careful out there; the open waters will have you feeling a little off after a while, but it’s nothing a good sleep won’t fix! For your Experts, however, best to keep an eye and make sure the unfathomable depths aren’t getting to them. Especially once you discover the Fathomless Winch, who knows what strange things you might see with that thing, and some things are best left alone.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/95b0b6d94a354a62abd290c88d7d6101c5682300.png"]
Explore three remote points of interest across the archipelago & unlock new decor
Dredge the depths to discover ten fresh catches. We’d advise you don’t set sail at night…
Fight the Unfathomable. Are your experts’ minds strong enough to gain knowledge of the depths?

[p align="start"]Pointians, if you’ve been with us since the beginning, you’ll know that Two Point Hospital turns 7 years old this month. As a small throwback to our origins, we’re excited to bring you the most sacred of fish: the Blob Fish. Originally added to the universe in the Exhibition pack for Two Point Hospital, The Blob returns in all his glory, fully realised in Two Point Museum.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/a475d4546c6796628a3e68e9938313ff9aa6b9ab.png"]

Brave Marine Life experts can explore the new Temple of the Blobs, found southwest on the Bone Belt underneath Hermit Hills. On this picturesque isle sits an ancient shrine to the most blobby of fish, a most sacred specimen to Wetlanteons since the dawn of watery time.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/69ab1406f632b9c61feaa1ea736ded7f3945dc22.png"]By exploring this new point of interest, you’ll unlock three new aquarium decor pieces alongside the Blob Fish exhibit. Your Wetlanteon guests will be so thrilled to see their beloved blob that they may just donate extra to see its greatness…

Curators, delve into adventure!

Curators across the planes, it’s time to polish your dice (and if they’re weighted, we’ll know), fluff your woolly hat, and for good measure, brew some dragon fire potions as we delve into the new, exciting adventures in update 4.0.

You can forget your everyday museum curation for now because we’re about to send you to the ends of the County’s map! The first grand adventure takes you deep into the Pointy Mountains; brave the peaks and befriend yetis as you uncover the truth behind what really happened to the mysteriously missing curator from Memento Mile.

Then, dust off the snow (and your dragon fire shields), as you’re whisked away to the fairy tale lands of Scorched Earth. Try not to get too lost in the whimsical enchantment, and remember, never follow a goblin off the beaten track, as there are six new exhibits to discover, and a party to assemble, in the Fantasy Finds taster.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/891cb3cdd30972f0b00cbd55474f94b3b476eef6.png"]
Gather a party to embark on a fantastical adventure ahead of our DLC release. The Fantasy Finds free content includes:
The ability to hire new Fantasy Experts
The first three Points of Interest in Scorched Earth: The Fledgling Arms, Fairydale and Wishfell

Two new Staff Traits
The ability to publish job ads for 1, 2 or 3 Experts of a specific type
Botany-themed Humidifier and Heater are available in career mode
More detailed Buzz ratings are now available in tour setup
….and much more!
A (literal) mountain of new content awaits, so let’s delve into our highlights! If you want to skip to the full changelist, it’s below!

Well, well, well. It seems our goblin friends have gone a little overboard with the whole “unleash the magic” button. Or perhaps they just really like shiny things, and couldn’t wait? Either way, fantastic news for you, curators! You can now start gathering your party early, in anticipation of the full Fantasy Finds adventure dropping on 17th July.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/e073890fc58de8058ec190efa23b05de0939f599.png"]

You can now embark on fairy tale (and slightly fiery) adventures to the first three Points of Interest in Scorched Earth! Unearth a treasure trove of fantastical exhibits and wondrous decor to really bring a tavern vibe to your museums. And the best bit? Everything you unlock from these first POIs is now in the base game, just like magic. It’s not a demo, you see, your hard-earned loot is yours to keep (if you keep the thieves at bay, that is).

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/91943c408e2d4f14cb49e377ff9286b9a0d3d351.png"]To explore the Fantasy Finds campaign, you’ll need to have completed Memento Mile Act 1, our lovely city location. Or if you just can’t wait, you can jump straight into the fantasy fray from the get-go, in sandbox mode.
Alright, curators, prepare yourself for the ultimate test of your curation skills. With your pointiest trowel and fluffiest brush at the ready, it’s time to open the frosted doors to Pointy Mountain.

Your museum career culminates in this brand-new finale museum, perched precariously atop the County’s Pointy Mountains. It’s got snow, it’s got mystery, it’s got yetis, and an incredibly chilly exhibit.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/74ec7119e16510c6109efea5fef83339461a4236.png"]

Once you’ve achieved Curator Class VII, this epic final museum unlocks. Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to unearth the truth behind that pesky missing curator, who we’d all just assumed had ran off. Best five new stars of gameplay as you befriend yetis to discover a new exhibit and entertain two new guest types, in our largest museum location to date.
Are you ready for the final frontier of museum management? Don’t forget your thermal underwear!

We’re excited to bring a closet of silly costumes as Twitch Drops return for Two Point Museum. Channels streaming the game can now opt in to these fabulous staff costumes, meaning you lovely viewers can earn free stuff whilst watching them curate. Drops are available for all players to earn, on both PC & console.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/03aa5b5ba4cfc98591f98359ace7f99e214d5407.png"]

Watch your favourite streamers from now until 7th August 2025 at 15:00 BST to grab these costumes celebrating the release of update 4.0. You can check out the full instructions on how to redeem drops (or set them up if you're streaming here.
The items do not offer any unfair bonuses to gameplay; they’re cosmetics for your staff members.

If you’re keen to jump into adventuring as quickly as possible, speed-run gathering your party of Wizards, Rogues and Bards by hiring multiple experts at once. When posting for a manual job ad, you can now select whether to advertise or 1, 2 or 3 roles at once - no more waiting around for job ads to become available.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/62326b33e57a64452aae68c51d01a8b10e3ae867.png"]We know how frustrating it is to play the negative trait lottery when hiring for roles, so not only can you now advertise for multiple positions at once, but we’ve also had an overhaul of the expert traits table so things are a little more balanced now, and experts will be less likely to have more than one negative trait.

Whilst not completely invisible, these camouflaged utility items lend themselves to creating immersive botany displays for your guests to enjoy. These items are now available in career mode and become available once the “Overgrowth Jungle” point of interest is unlocked in the Two Point Sea expedition map.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/f648d5dca59b736b205920091117693af3b031e4.png"]

releases.displayName: Sunkiss Creek | New Summer Seasonal Update!

items.text: Hey Curators,

Pack your trunks and slap on some sun-cream, as we prepare to embark on a grand summer expedition! We’re off to Sunkiss Creek, with its cool waters offering travellers a spot of respite. It’s the perfect time to dip your toes in the shimmering cove of this delightful new locale.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/aeb7c08aff6c178557564ebe2f87964db88cc0ac.png"]
Dive into Sunkiss Creek!

Not only a place of quiet reflection in these bustling summer months, the creek is a great spot for fishing, with fantastic seasonal catches. These aquatic wonders, whilst somewhat unusual, will have your bog-standard guests, alongside marine life enthusiasts, gasping with delight. This prime fishing spot is only available during the summer months, so get your nets ready and delve into its depths before the end of the season!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/4a10fa8acf00348f0427d855a27279dc8cce4ec8.png"]

Keen-eyed Curators who brave the waters of Sunkiss Creek won’t just reel in new exhibits, as you’ll discover a trove of delightful new items to spruce up your museum halls as well! Imagine laying back in a comfy deck chair (for a midday nap or to catch some rays) alongside your favourite cornetto. It’s worth a museum trip just for that, don’t you think? Alongside new items, dress up your staff in a brand-spanking new outfit, because even your tireless employees deserve to look their summery best (and yes, they might even get a holiday… eventually).
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/9ab8e2cfd70cd8a45ae8586157f0cd0fd5d3f1e3.png"]So, what’s new?
A brand-new main menu theme
A fresh Point of Interest with 3 new Marine Life exhibits - prepare for some truly unique finds.
A lovely new Ice Cream Kiosk, because what’s a trip to the museum without a little treat?
Five new decorative items: adorn your grounds with the charming Birdhouse (complete with pigeon). A majestic Sundial and splashingly good Fountain, a shady Parasol and vibrant new Summer Banners.
Four new utility items: practical and pretty! A new Summer Bench and Bin set, Deck Chair and handy Information Stand
Two new wallpaper and flooring options to give your exhibits a summer makeover.
A dashing Summer Staff outfit, so your employees can look cool whilst they work… or you know, just look cool.
Three new music tracks, tap your toes to the rhythm of summer!
How does it work?

A shimmering new seasonal POI (that’s Point of Interest!) has appeared on the Bone Belt Expedition Map. Now, these Seasonal POIs are a bit special; they only pop up during the seasonal event time. So, plan your expeditions to Sunkiss Creek and get ready to net those fantastic new exhibits while the summer event is live!

Fear not, we wouldn’t dream of rushing your leisurely fishing trips. Sunkiss Creek will remain open for prime-time angling until 31st August. And don’t worry, we’ll give you plenty of reminders before it’s time to pack away the rods and tackle.

And the best bit: decorations are forever! Once you’ve unlocked the lovely seasonal decorative items, they’re yours to keep, no matter the season. Plus, the seasonal POI will make an annual return, just like the turning of the seasons themselves. So, you can always revisit Sunkiss Creek next year for another splash!
Hey Curators!

Hold onto your brushes, Curators, because summer in Two Point County is just heating up, and so is your favourite museum sim! We’ve got a jam-packed season ahead, and this update? Consider it the picky bits before the main BBQ event.

Expect new content, seasonal delights, and quality-of-life updates alongside optimisation - tonnes of lovely Two Point goodness to keep your museum halls buzzing over the warmer months. But the best part? The cherry on top? To add some extra ✨sparkle✨ to all this lovely new content, this update is thanks to YOU.

We couldn’t do this without every single one of you brilliant (and occasionally chaotic) Curators who’ve sent us your thoughts, feedback, and fantastic ideas. We’ve been listening, we’ve been brewing, and whilst there’s exciting new content still cooking we’re here to do one thing to kick-start a fantastic summer: deliver!
New Memorial Exhibit Items for MIA staff; statues, busts, plinths and plaques
30 new posters across the cafe and gift shop
Expedition randomisation overhaul (first trialled on select POIs)
Batching workshop items
Staff XP changes & 6 Staff Traits
Further security improvements
Community-inspired quality-of-life changes
…and much more!

We’ve all lost staff members (and some more than others). Whether you’re a careful curator and have only lost your cherished Derek Mayonnaise (who went missing on the quest for those pesky Sickly Pears). Or, you're the kind of player with complete disregard for County employment laws, which heavily impacts your staff turnaround. Either way, you’ll be glad to know you now have a permanent way to remember your beloved (or sacrificial) staff members. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/be35f571904cd345fc69a02c9b2b0388747992b5.png"]

Now when you receive the dreaded news that Toilet Terror, Tracy Plunge, hasn’t returned from your latest expedition endeavour, you’ll receive a memorial item to remember them. The type of item is dependent on the staff member's rank, as well as their staff type and gender. From a humble plaque to a gigantic statue, for those high-level losses.

These memorial exhibits are engraved with your staff member’s name, alongside their years of service and where they went MIA, so you’ll never forget the perilous journey that ultimately met their demise. Guests can admire your wall of shame (or fame), as they would traditional exhibits. You can create a memorial garden, to do your trusty staff members justice, or, shove them in an unused corner.
Don’t want to remember them? You’re a fire and rehire kinda museum manager, huh? Well, lucky for you, memorial exhibits can be sold, you cold-hearted capitalist.

We’ve seen your requests for new items, and wall decor, alongside more items for your rooms, came in joint first in community requests. You can now showcase the gift shop posters being sold to your guests, with each of our six exhibit themes having four poster variants. You’ll need the MEGA store to beat all megastores to showcase them all at once, and they are lovely if we say so ourselves.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/0c88794cceb9f95a90728aa3359480a525586e27.png"]

In the cafe, show off your favourite Two Point County brands with the new Cafeteria posters. You can customise your walls with six new posters, from Dinosaur Nuggets to Hog-Logs Cereal, there’s a fan-favourite food for every Pointian.

RNG not manifesting that pesky missing exhibit? We’ve overhauled randomisation to give us more control to fine-tune expeditions, so there’s (hopefully) no need to repeat the same expeditions over and over, and over, again.

Now, fine-tuning things is a tricky job, so we’ve gone with a phased approach to iterate on randomisation. This ensures we don’t inadvertently make things worse by upsetting the RNG powers that be. Our goal with these changes is to ensure greater control over quality distribution, alongside ensuring you see each exhibit across a set amount of expeditions.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/1cf0ee0b6f5a622fddb9e22f1ee66c628c145df5.png"]
These POIs are smarter, knowing when you’ve not received an exhibit for a long time. For now, we’ve introduced this new randomisation model to:
Cold Mines
Downtown Wetlantis
Greasy Fields
Carrion Trail
Ginormous Rock
Darkest Depths
Rib Row
Endless Dump
From here, we’ll monitor feedback on these POIs and increase the number which use this new system over time. We want to get this right, so please let us know how you get on!

A heavily requested feature, from all of you, our lovely curators, was the ability to batch or queue up workshop projects. This enables you to create several of the same workshop projects at once, freeing up your time for more important tasks, like noodling around with prehistoric ferns or laying new carpets.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147557/29799d4cbb38ca1ae1e72fa5e5664cdc691828b9.png"]You’ll now have the ability to create 1, 3, 5 or 10 workshop items at once, enabling you to stockpile expedition essentials like checks notes Rank Cheese…? Each item is built sequentially, so you’ll get the first copy of the cargo item in the same amount of time. Batching items together will increase the upfront cost of beginning the project, however, cancelling midway through will reimburse you.
As usual, this update also comes with a load of bug fixes, improvements and optimisation changes.

A huge thank you to you, our community! Whether you’ve just started curating or have been around since the Two Point Hospital days, we are ecstatic with how the launch for Museum has gone, and it’s all down to your positivity; whether you’ve shared your museum build, a top tip, or sent us a message with your ideas and feedback, it’s been overwhelmingly lovely watching you curate, and we can’t thank you enough for putting your faith in us and for playing our games
If you’d like to send us your thoughts for future content or updates, or show us your fab museums, here’s the place to do that:

Welcome Curators!

We’re bringing you a crate full of changes, jammed full of new stuff, quality of life updates, and optimisations - all that good stuff. And, to add some extra ✨sparkle✨ to all this lovely new content, this update is thanks to YOU. Yes, to all of you lovely curators who’ve sent us your thoughts, feedback and ideas, we’re here to do one thing: deliver!
23 floors & wallpapers
2 Staff Room items & 14 Staff Traits
Sandbox customisation options
A new 360° camera and the outdoor camera can now be placed inside
Requested quality of life changes to staff- traits in training, and more!
New extra large UI (handy for Steam Deck)
Requested Expedition Discovery changes
Community-inspired security changes
…and much more!
Let’s delve into our highlights, and if you want to skip to the full changelog, it’s below!

We asked Discord what to prioritise first, and they chose new wallpaper and floors! We’ve seen LOADS of requests for more options so you can truly customise your guest’s experience. The biggest asks we’ve seen across our community hubs was for a snowier option for your iced exhibits and some more neutral options - especially some darker walls for your hauntingly beautiful hotels.
(with more to come, too!)

We heard you loud and clear and have delivered new sandbox options so you’re able to fine-tune your experience in sandbox mode even further. Want to build one big mega-museum and not change locations? You can now toggle off ‘Curator Class’, and even unlock all Enlightenment Decor, Kudosh Items, and Custom Contraptions. That way, you have everything at your disposal for the ultimate cosy curation experience.

We’ve added a bunch of neat quality of life changes based on the feedback that’s been coming in, as well as changes so your staff are not only happier (yay!) but also gain XP quicker (woo!). And, in the event of something going terribly wrong, you’ll receive ‘missing in action’ inbox messages, so there’s no missing if your favourite Expert, Fanny McBoatface, is eaten by a giant plant.

Alongside two new staff room items to ensure your staff are kept well-fed and happy, there's awesome new additions to staff traits, giving your staff that unique feel that only Two Point County can deliver. To make specialising your staff easier, when training staff you'll now see their traits in the same menu, so training up your elite expedition squad has never been easier.

Like Marmite, you either get on fine with thieves in Two Point Museum or absolutely hate their addition. Whilst it may be impossible to bring those in the #removethieves camp around, the team has really knocked their heads together to come up with a big list of changes and improvements to ensure less friction with the security mechanic.

The top two frustrations we’ve heard are: first, players feeling like they need to micro-manage their guards to ensure they’re chasing thieves and, well, doing what you’re paying them for. Second, thieves getting away even if you feel you’ve done everything you can to deter them. So, what have we changed?

First, to cameras, we’ve added a new free-standing 360 camera, which will slowly patrol in a circle to cover a wide area of your museum. You can now also place the ‘outdoor’ camera indoors, adding more options to your museum security arsenal. Plus, one change to thieves is that they’re no longer scared by cameras, and instead of running away, once a camera spots them it will call a security guard to the thief if available.

To stop thieves speedily getting away, they now don’t run as fast, giving your guards extra opportunity to catch up to them. Plus, the pesky Molars (who were causing a lot of underground chaos) have different decision-making, so they no longer nab the closest exhibit to their hide-y hole. We’ve also improved how quickly guards are assigned to thieves and fixed issues where thieves weren’t being captured near an escape point.

To round off the quality of life changes, we’ve got improvements to Expedition Discovery and Exhibits, so your curation life is smoother! Now when inspecting an Exhibit or checking it out in the sticker book, you can see which point of interest it’s from and even open the map straight to that POI’s location. No more searching in vain to remember where to find your favourite exhibits!

We’ve also made loads of tweaks and changes, so it’s much easier to find Pristine Exhibits once you’ve fully surveyed a point of interest. And we’ve buffed survey progress for both Detailed and Safe Expeditions! Once you discover an exhibit, you can see its traits straight out of the crate on the exhibit reveal screen.

To make any creative curator’s life easier, we’ve done a full sweep looking at the boundaries and boxes surrounding items and exhibits to make improvements when you’re placing things down. Plus, when installing perks on an exhibit, any non-relevant perks in your inventory will now show and be grayed out with some extra information if they don’t apply to the item you’ve selected.
As usual, this update also comes with a load of bug fixes, improvements and optimisation changes. We’ve also upgraded our game engine, Unity, which should bring improvements, too.

A huge thank you to you, our community! Whether you’ve just started curating or have been around since the Two Point Hospital days, we are ecstatic with how the launch for Museum has gone, and it’s all down to your positivity; whether you’ve shared your museum build, a top tip, or sent us a message with your ideas and feedback, it’s been overwhelmingly lovely watching you curate, and we can’t thank you enough for putting your faith in us and for playing our games
If you’d like to send us your thoughts for future content or updates, or show us your fab museums, here’s the place to do that:
Discord TikTok BlueSky
Twitter Instagram Facebook
Love from Abby & the Two Point Team <3
(P.S. One of the best things you can do to help support the studio is to leave a Steam Review! If you’ve tried your hand at curating, we’d love to hear your feedback. Thank you!)
